extracted.name: Cherry tomato & Philly Intense macaroni
extracted.description: Try this creamy macaroni for an easy date night dinner that you can whip up in only 20 minutes
ingredient_lines: a handful of basil leaves torn
instruction_lines: Cook the pasta following pack instructions. Meanwhile, heat the olive oil in a medium frying pan over a medium heat, and cook the tomatoes with a pinch of salt for 6-8 mins until starting to soften and burst.

Drain the pasta, reserving 3 tbsp water, and add the pasta to the tomatoes, along with the Philadelphia Intense Garlic & Herbs. Mix everything together over a low heat, adding a splash of pasta water to loosen, and season. Scatter with the basil to serve.
